objective: Create task and test lists by repeatedly decomposing only where smaller coherent obligations improve verified whole-task completion, including planning and integration effort.
scope: Question templates and proposed local contracts, not a directly sendable API request or an implemented runtime.

child_count.instructions: Choose how many execution units this node needs. Preserve every source obligation and test expectation. Use 1 only when the current node has one coherent outcome, explicit inputs and outputs, adequate verification criteria, known dependencies and no unresolved design gap. Otherwise choose a feasible child count that creates useful independently verifiable boundaries after accounting for planning, handoff, shared writes and integration effort. Do not choose more children merely because splitting is possible.

criteria.1: Keep this node as one execution leaf; do not create a duplicate child.
criteria.2: Replace this execution obligation with two nonempty, strictly smaller children.
criteria.3: Replace this execution obligation with three nonempty, strictly smaller children.
criteria.4: Replace this execution obligation with four nonempty, strictly smaller children.
criteria.5: Replace this execution obligation with five nonempty, strictly smaller children.

anchor.instructions: Choose an unassigned source obligation as this child's concrete responsibility anchor. Keep earlier assignments fixed. Prefer a coherent outcome with explicit verification criteria; do not invent missing requirements or new source text.
anchor.criteria_source: Feasible unassigned obligation IDs with verbatim source and expected behavior.

assign_obligation.instructions: Choose the child that should own this source obligation, considering existing anchors, current assignments, interfaces, related tests and required write serialization. Preserve the meaning of the obligation and a feasible completion of all remaining assignments.
assign_obligation.criteria_source: Feasible child IDs with their current obligations, outcomes and interfaces.

test_scope.instructions: Select the smallest scope that can actually verify this source-backed expectation without changing its inputs or expected result. A multi-child expectation remains an integration check. An existing whole-product acceptance check must be preserved. If no candidate can verify it, report a preparation gap before this question rather than inventing an oracle.
test_scope.criteria_source: Relevant single-child scope IDs plus integration and whole-product scope IDs supported by the required artifacts.

runtime_proposal.unit_source: Source-linked obligation clauses and acceptance scenarios; optional generated clarification must be separately attributed and costed.
runtime_proposal.loop: Review a versioned leaf, choose count, choose anchors, assign remaining obligations, link tests, validate and commit a strictly progressing replacement, then review new leaves.
runtime_proposal.same_file_writes: Serialize initially; never infer concurrent write safety from different task titles.
runtime_proposal.single_feasible_option: Validate and record the deterministic choice without calling Choice.

worker_instructions: Implement the selected leaf against its task entry, linked test specifications, supplied source excerpts and shared interface contract. Preserve public requirements and expected results. Write only the assigned scope under controller ownership. Read accepted dependency artifacts where needed. Do not repartition the entire goal or modify other workers' obligations. Report missing source facts and concrete expected-versus-observed issues. Test specifications are not executed tests; report checks as not run unless an actual authorized runner supplied results. Parent and whole-product acceptance require their own integration checks.
